Limavady United Football Club is a semi-professional, Northern Irish football club playing in the NIFL Championship, the second tier of Irish football but will play in NIFL Premiership from 2026 to 2027 season after promotion in 2025–26.\nThe club comes from Limavady, County Londonderry, and plays home matches at the Showgrounds. Club colours are royal blue shirts with white trim, blue socks and royal blue shorts. Away colours are all yellow. The current manager is Paul Owens, with assistant manager and ex player Charlie Moore.
